integrity: Empirical-process limit plus local block conditional variance prove the statement for all n asymptotically. Finite enumeration and moment checks are supplementary and do not substitute for the infinite proof. The one-position center limit and exact finite covariances are credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite set of distinct offsets and uniform permutations only; finite-dimensional convergence; no rate and no functional limit for a growing number of positions. Unlocated earlier results under different terminology may affect historical priority.
title: A shared Brownian-bridge law in the central degree window of random permutation graphs
